verdict.rationale: This story asks whether a collection of agent skills keeps tests or evals for those skills. Kino AI is a video-editing app with an MCP server and agent editing, not a skills collection, so the axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Kino ships a skills collection, so the exception that would make the axis applicable does not arise.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection maintains tests or evals for its skills so changes are verified against regressions rather than shipped on vibes
